$comment: Public copy surface declaration (Issue #506). A changed file is public copy only when it matches a publicCopyGlobs entry and no excludeGlobs entry. The gate extracts the Japanese text a pull request changed in those files and asks for an owner approval record (quality/copy-editorial-approvals.json). The list is opt-in: a file that is not listed here is out of scope, and the report says so per file, so a missing entry is visible rather than silent.
policy: The surfaces are visitor-facing: the Japanese text a reader of https://rebuildup.dev sees. Internal documents, skills, scripts, tests, Storybook samples, design-system demo routes and the authenticated /admin surfaces are not public copy and are not gated here. Extending this list is an owner copy decision, not a mechanical one.
